paragraphs.text: Ranna Beleren is a healer on the plane of Vryn , and Planeswalker Jace Beleren 's mother.

Ranna is a short, slim, mature woman with brown hair, frizzed with gray, and clearwater-blue eyes. She wears reading glasses. She developed a method using phoenix feathers as an alternative to organ replacement. Though she practices healing magic, she can use offensive magic with scalpel spells.

In Jace's youth, Ranna's skin was peachy and freckled, her chestnut hair pulled back from her tired eyes. Although she struggled with alcoholism after she first believed Jace had died, she had begun sobriety by the time of his later presumed death in the Meditation Realm.

Ranna gave birth to their son Jace in 4534 AR . After Jace's presumed death fifteen years later, she developed an alcohol habit, and she and her husband Gav Beleren split. Leaving her hospital to join the army as a field medic, she later participated in the defense of Vryn during the New Phyrexian Invasion in 4562 AR . In the immediate aftermath of the Invasion, Jace planeswalked into her living room with Vraska in a desperate bid to save them both from the wounds they had suffered and the effects of compleation .

After Jace was shattered in the Meditation Realm , Vraska returned to Vryn with the couple's adopted son Loot . The two stayed with Ranna for several months, mourning their loss. In the late autumn of 4565, Chandra Nalaar and Ajani Goldmane arrived on Vryn to inform Vraska that Jace was in fact alive and attempting to overlay the Echoverse over the Multiverse .
